en.headline: Hong Kong Shue Yan University opens new college of communication and creative industries
en.dek: The private university marked its 55th anniversary on Saturday by announcing the establishment of its fourth faculty and the enrolment of nearly 2,500 new students this academic year.
body: Hong Kong Shue Yan University announced on Saturday the establishment of a new School of Communication, Information and Creative Industries as it celebrated its 55th anniversary. President Hu Huai-chung said the school had been approved by the Hong Kong Council for Accreditation of Academic and Vocational Qualifications for the current academic year.

The new faculty integrates the long-standing Department of Journalism and Communication with the more recently established Department of Data Science and Digital Innovation. Hu said the university would further embed artificial intelligence and digital humanities across its programmes.

The university enrolled 2,497 new students this year, including 411 postgraduate students. Non-local students now make up nearly 30 per cent of the total student body. Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki, an alumnus, and Education Secretary Christine Choi attended the anniversary lunch.

zh.headline: 樹仁大學成立傳理資訊及創意產業學院 迎約2500新生
zh.dek: 樹仁大學周六慶祝創校55周年，宣布獲批成立第四所學院，新學年錄取近2500名新生，非本地生佔近三成。
body: 香港樹仁大學周六舉行55周年校慶午宴，校長胡懷中宣布本學年獲學術及職業資歷評審局批准成立「傳理、資訊及創意產業學院」，成為大學第四所學院。
新學院整合新聞與傳播學系及數據科學及數字創新學系，大學將進一步推動人工智能及數碼人文發展。胡懷中表示，新學年共錄取2497名新生，包括411名碩士及博士研究生，非本地生現佔總學生人數近三成。
政務司司長陳國基及教育局局長蔡若蓮等出席午宴並頒發長期服務獎。陳國基表示政府正推廣「留學香港」品牌，支持自資專上院校發展。
